summary: Implemented Graph.cbd in rdflib/graph.py (last method of Graph, before ConjunctiveGraph) with a nested recursive helper add_to_cbd covering the three W3C CBD rules: subject triples, recursive blank-node expansion guarded by "result has no triple with that subject", and reification via rdf:subject with no type or predicate/object matching. Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase (setUp parses Turtle fixture and binds ex; tearDown closes graph) covering counts, typed and untyped reifiers, incoming-reification exclusion, blank-node-in-reifier non-expansion, blank-node cycle, and source immutability. Nothing was run, per instructions. Nothing committed. Caveat: my fixture gives 6 (not the spec's 8) for the blank-node resource and 2 for the property resource, and the tests assert these values; the reified counts 8 and 13 match the spec.
